name: Ring Frenzy VR
summary:
Welcome to Ring Frenzy, the ultimate VR game of skill, speed, and fun! Immerse yourself in an exciting arena where you must grab and throw rings onto sticks scattered across the playfield. Each ring you land on a stick boosts your score, but with the clock ticking down, you'll need quick reflexes and precision to win.
